scripts.test: node tests/core.mjs && node tests/demo.mjs && node tests/demo-intro.mjs && node tests/console-delivery.mjs
scripts.deploy: npm run build && firebase deploy --only hosting,firestore --project havat-ravve
scripts.emulators: npm run build && firebase emulators:start --project demo-havat-ravve
scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-havat-ravve "node tests/rules.mjs && node tests/rules-app.mjs"
scripts.test:api: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,auth --project demo-havat-ravve "node tests/api.mjs && node tests/api-v2-tasks.mjs && node tests/api-v2-events.mjs && node tests/api-v2-farm.mjs"
scripts.dev: npm run build && firebase emulators:start --only hosting,firestore,auth --project demo-havat-ravve
scripts.build:ios: npm run build && node scripts/build-native.mjs && cap sync ios
scripts.build:android: npm run build && node scripts/build-native.mjs && cap sync android
